description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.005 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Token risk score: one ERC-20 token scored (0-100) with a short AI verdict (Workers AI rephrasing only the computed facts; rule-based fallback), risk level, evidence flags, taxes, holder concentration, owner status and DEX liquidity. Base or Ethereum. Data: GoPlus Security public API (contract flags, taxes, honeypot simulation, holders, LP lock) + DexScreener (pairs, liquidity, volume). Every flag names its source field. Not financial advice. When to use: Use token-score for a quick risk score + AI verdict on one token before a trade. Use rug-check for a pass/fail breakdown, token-compare to pick between two, token-portfolio for up to 20 tokens, token-risk for our own on-chain bytecode analysis.
